run_simple_demo: run the simple multimodal demo to describe a single image using Mistral-Small-3.1
run_advanced_demo: run the advanced multimodal demo with multiple images and multi-turn conversation
parse_args: parse command line arguments for demo mode, model format, and mm processor cache flag
main: run the offline inference demo for Mistral-Small-3.1 with simple or advanced mode
llm_chat: call llm.chat with multimodal messages containing text and image URLs for inference
